name: io.github.andreasjhagen/computer-controller
description: MCP server for desktop automation: launch apps, capture screenshots, control mouse and keyboard

environmentVariables.name: DISPLAY_INDEX
environmentVariables.description: Restrict all screenshot and display operations to this specific monitor (0-indexed). Leave empty to allow access to all displays.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to scale screenshots to 1000×1000 (letterboxed) for Gemini's native coordinate system.
